FN-C63CJJ-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 144
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Representative Jim Hill
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/05/2023
REVISED - 4/4/2023
House Bill 144 as introduced establishes a certification and testing process for foreign language
interpreters administered by the Administrative Office of Courts (AOC). According to AOC, the
one-time cost for testing is $940; the one-time certification fee for a Spanish exam is $385
($350 for oral exam and $35 for written exam) and other languages oral exam is $690. AOC
estimates this bill would increase receipts to the State Judicial Administration Fund by an
estimated $2,100 annually, based on projected number of interpreters to be certified.
